title: Matrix Reprogrammed Monetisation Dashboard
mission: Matrix Reprogrammed is a public-record intelligence machine mapping people, institutions, money, policy, jurisdictions, families, societies, think tanks, legal systems, narratives and missing records.
logic: Traffic → email capture → free brief/download → membership/report/deck/book/custom research.

revenueConclusions.conclusion: Build and sell the Matrix Reprogrammed Card Deck Bundle first.
revenueConclusions.whyItMatters: The card system already contains 468 cards, direct dossiers, downloads and artwork queues.
revenueConclusions.evidenceBoundary: This is a monetisation recommendation, not revenue proof.
revenueConclusions.missingRecord: Payment provider, PDF export and delivery automation.
revenueConclusions.nextAction: Connect payment provider and generate paid deck bundle PDF.

revenueConclusions.conclusion: Use the free sample card deck plus Daily Control Brief signup.
revenueConclusions.whyItMatters: It connects the visual card hook to recurring email capture.
revenueConclusions.evidenceBoundary: Email conversion depends on traffic and provider setup.
revenueConclusions.missingRecord: Email provider integration and conversion tracking.
revenueConclusions.nextAction: Connect email provider and add form actions.

revenueConclusions.conclusion: Lead users from free brief to €19 Intelligence Member.
revenueConclusions.whyItMatters: The full card intelligence, source ledger and missing-record queue match the core site mission.
revenueConclusions.missingRecord: Payment/subscription backend and member access control.
revenueConclusions.nextAction: Implement checkout and protected member pages.

products.title: Top 52 People of Interest Report

products.title: Institutions of Control Report
products.description: A structured guide to institutional routes: mandate, funding, standards, regulation, implementation and public-private pathways.

products.title: Jurisdictions of Power Atlas
products.description: A jurisdictional map of Vatican/Holy See, City of London, Washington D.C., offshore centres, tax routes, registries and legal venues.

products.title: Power Families Dossier
products.description: A family-route dossier focused on public wealth, foundations, companies, boards, philanthropy, media and institutions.

products.title: Black Nobility Historical Dossier
products.description: A source-bounded historical-genealogical dossier on papal nobility, Italian patrician houses and allied dynastic networks.

products.title: Think Tanks Policy Influence Report
products.description: A policy-influence report mapping think tanks, fellows, reports, funders where disclosed, boards and policy pathways.

products.title: Secret Societies Public Record Guide
products.description: A documented-history guide to orders, societies, lodges, clubs and symbolic networks with myth separated from record.

products.title: Policy Convergence Tracker
products.description: A convergence tracker for policy frameworks moving identity, money, health, speech, climate and governance toward global coordination.

products.title: Digital ID / Surveillance Tracker
products.description: A focused tracker for digital identity, credentials, biometrics, surveillance infrastructure and policy routes.

products.title: CBDC / One World Currency Tracker
products.description: A money-route tracker for CBDCs, payment rails, central banks, asset managers, stablecoins and financial infrastructure.
